Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.modelPackage.cardsFolder.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.modelPackage.cardsFolder.characterCards.CharacterCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPickable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Artist, Builder, Farmer, Hunter, Inventor, Shaman
public abstract class CharacterCard extends Card implements IPickable
Abstract base class for character cards. All type-specific getters (prestige points, discount, icon, etc.) return 0 or a default value unless a concrete subclass overrides them.
